sloka: स मां दृष्ट्वा नरपतिर्मुष्टिविक्षेपतत्पर: ।पांसुकुण्ठितसर्वाङ्गीं जनको विस्मितो ऽभवत् ॥ २.११८.२९॥
transliteration: sa māṁ dṛṣṭvā narapatirmuṣṭivikṣepatatpara: ।pāṁsukuṇṭhitasarvāṅgīṁ janako vismito 'bhavat ॥ 2.118.29॥

translations.english: Engaged in sowing fistfuls of seeds, king Janaka found me covered with dust and was astonished.
